21243-the-madigans.title: The Madigans
21243-the-madigans.creator: Miriam Michelson
21243-the-madigans.description: A book by Miriam Michelson. She felt so virtuous already that the carrying out of her intentions seemed really supererogatory. When she went to Irene to have her button her dress in the back, she had such a sensation of holiness, such a consciousness of a forbearing, pure, and gentle spirit, that her sister's malicious pretense of ignoring her presence appeared to her nothing less than sacrilege.

arxiv-2203-02457.title: The Arithmetic-Periodicity of cut for 𝒞 = { 1 , 2 ​ c } \mathcal{C}=\{1,2c\}
arxiv-2203-02457.creator: Paul Ellis, Thotsaporn Aek Thanatipanonda
arxiv-2203-02457.description: Abstract cut is a class of partition games played on a finite number of finite piles of tokens. Each version of cut is specified by a cut-set 𝒞 ⊆ ℕ \mathcal{C}\subseteq\mathbb{N} . A legal move consists of selecting one of the piles and partitioning it into d + 1 d+1 nonempty piles, where d ∈ 𝒞 d\in\mathcal{C} .

arxiv-2206-07323.title: A Continuous Risk Assessment Methodology for Cloud Infrastructures
arxiv-2206-07323.creator: Immanuel Kunz, Angelika Schneider and Christian Banse
arxiv-2206-07323.description: Abstract Cloud systems are dynamic environments which make it difficult to keep track of security risks that resources are exposed to. Traditionally, risk assessment is conducted for individual assets to evaluate existing threats; their results, however, are quickly outdated in such a dynamic environment.

arxiv-2209-05289.title: Semileptonic weak Hamiltonian to 𝒪 ⁡ ( α ​ α s ) \mathcal{O}(\alpha\alpha_{s}) in momentum-space subtraction schemes
arxiv-2209-05289.creator: M. Gorbahn, S. Jäger, F. Moretti, and E. van der Merwe
arxiv-2209-05289.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by M. Gorbahn, S. Jäger, F. Moretti, and E. van der Merwe. The CKM unitarity precision test of the Standard Model requires a systematic treatment of electromagnetic and strong corrections for semi-leptonic decays. Electromagnetic corrections require the renormalization of a semileptonic four-fermion operator. In this work we calculate the 𝒪 ⁡ ( α ​ α s ) \mathcal{O}(\alpha\alpha_{s}) perturbative scheme conversion between the MS ¯ \overline{\rm MS} scheme and several momentum-space subtraction schemes, which can also be implemented on the lattice.

arxiv-2504-00514.description: Abstract The interaction between light and vapors in the presence of magnetic fields is fundamental to many quantum technologies and applications. arxiv-2510-10358.description: Abstract Concerns about the misuse and misinterpretation of p p -values and statistical significance have motivated alternatives for quantifying evidence. pmc-13333201.creator: Yuta Yamagishi, Yoshiki Sonoyama, Naoki Kawakami, Tomonori Hasebe, Masayuki Su’etsugu
pmc-13333201.description: Autonomous self-reproduction is a major goal of bottom-up synthetic biology aimed at building artificial cells. While the reconstituted Escherichia coli chromosomal replication system, termed the Replication-Cycle Reaction (RCR) system, offers a promising platform for genome-scale replication, its generation from genetic information has not yet been achieved.
